product_metadata.title: iDesign Spa Microfiber Polyester Bath Mat, Non-Slip Shower Accent Rug for Master, Guest, and Kids' Bathroom, Entryway, 34" x 21", Chocolate Brown
features: HIGH QUALITY FABRIC: Made of 100% microfiber polyester, this non-slip chocolate brown shower rug adds comfort and chic style to your master bathroom, kitchen, kids' bathroom, guest bathroom, office, craft room, and other places in your home
STURDY: Stays in place throughout the day with a non-skid, no-slip backing
EASY MAINTENANCE: This bathroom rug is machine washable and hangs dry for easy cleaning
DRIES FAST: Soft to touch, designed to absorb water quickly, and dries fast for a fresh appearance
IDEAL SIZE: Measures 34" x 21" and fits beautifully in front of any shower, tub, or sink
description: Treat yourself with the iDesign Bathroom Rug! Crafted of plush microfiber polyester, this chocolate brown color is designed with a classic border and is just too stylish to resist. Made of 100% microfiber polyester, the rug is soft to the touch and features a non-skid, no slip backing. It's designed to absorb water quickly and dry fast. When it comes time to freshen up, just throw it in the wash and let it air dry! Also great to use in entryways or kitchens. Measuring 34" x 21", this rug will go perfectly in your bathroom. With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
